recognize_zh: 中倍視野中央的嗜中性球（綠線）四周貼滿一圈紅血球形成玫瑰花狀（rosette），周圍多處紅血球重疊成不規則團塊（黃線，agglutination）；兩者並見提示紅血球表面有抗體或補體結合。
features: Segmented neutrophil encircled by a ring of adherent red cells (rosette, green line)
Multiple irregular red cell agglutinates scattered through the field (yellow lines)
Agglutinates are clustered rather than linear coin stacks
Occasional crenated red cells and scattered normal platelets
No nucleated red cells or schistocytes evident in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows multiple irregular red cell agglutinates and a central segmented neutrophil surrounded by a rosette of adherent red cells. Occasional crenated red cells and normal-appearing platelets are present; schistocytes and nucleated red cells are not seen in this field. Findings of red cell agglutination with rosetting around neutrophils are suggestive of immune-mediated hemolytic anemia with antibody- or complement-coated red cells, to be correlated with the direct antiglobulin test.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear coin stacks without rosetting and disperse on saline replacement.
Satellitism shows platelets, not red cells, ringing neutrophils and is an EDTA-dependent artifact.
Drying artifact produces uneven clumping in thick areas without circumferential red cell adherence to neutrophils.
